title.t: A platform cuts an approved ad short

when.t: A report arrives that a platform truncated an approved ad.

steps.t: Agent 12 treats the cut as an edit and sends the cut copy back to Compliance (Agent 17).

Compliance checks the cut copy as the platform reports it. In the test the cut drops the brokerage identification, so Compliance flags it (no exceptions for format limits, 17-07) and Agent 12 asks the authorized user for corrected copy.

steps.t: If Compliance approves the cut copy, that copy is what is published, held for the authorized user's release (fixed 2026-10-27: the approval used to publish nothing).
There is no connection to any ad platform: this reaches Agent 12 only as an incoming message of that kind.

never.t: Accept a platform's cut as if it were the approved ad.

you_see.t: A question saying Compliance flagged the copy, with its findings.
you_see.src: flow:12-01:12->queue clarification.request; dispatcher/listing_spokes_12.py::Compliance (17) flagged the campaign copy

test.t: A listing goes live and its ad is held for release; then a report says Facebook cut the copy to "3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1800 sq ft...".

when.t: A report arrives that a platform rejected an ad.

steps.t: Agent 12 logs the rejection word for word and asks the authorized user. It changes nothing to get past the platform's filter.
There is no connection to any ad platform: this reaches Agent 12 only as an incoming message of that kind.

never.t: Change targeting to get past a filter.

test.t: Facebook rejects the ad: "AD_REJECTED: housing category requires special ad category".

when.t: Engagement figures for one listing have arrived from more than one platform and they differ.

steps.t: Agent 12 logs both, named by platform, and asks the authorized user.
Figures are kept per platform: different numbers from two platforms count as a disagreement, and a second figure from the same platform replaces the first.
There is no connection to any ad platform: this reaches Agent 12 only as an incoming message of that kind.

you_see.t: A question listing both figures with their platforms.

test.t: Facebook reports 40 and Zillow 55 for the same listing.

title.t: The listing is not confirmed active on the MLS

when.t: An approved ad for a listing is ready and the listing is not active, and no exempt status with its disclosure is on file.

steps.t: Agent 12 publishes nothing and keeps the ad.

The ad goes forward on its own once the listing goes active, or an exempt status with its disclosure on file is recorded; it then waits for the authorized user's release, because the dispatcher holds every publish.
An ad from Agent 04 that is waiting for the gate is on the calendar's list of waits, like a campaign the authorized user started (fixed 2026-10-28; before, nobody was told it was waiting).

never.t: Publish before the listing is confirmed active or documented exempt.

test.t: A listing package is signed without go-live; photos arrive and the description is approved.

title.t: A campaign ties into a trending topic

when.t: A signed new campaign is marked as tying into a trending topic.

steps.t: Agent 12 asks the authorized user to approve it first; it is not sent to Compliance.

never.t: Publish a trending-topic tie-in without the authorized user's approval.

you_see.t: A question asking for approval of the tie-in.

test.t: A signed campaign "Open house Sunday" marked as a trending-topic tie-in.

title.t: An ad mentions something not in the listing record

when.t: An ad from Agent 04 is marked as citing facts not in the listing record.

steps.t: The rule: pull it and ask. The code does this.
No way in: Agent 04 drafts only from the listing record and never sets the mark.

never.t: Let marketing say more than the listing record.

title.t: Compliance has not given a verdict

when.t: Copy is waiting for Compliance's verdict.

steps.t: Nothing publishes until the verdict arrives.
Without a ruleset loaded, Compliance gives no verdict and asks the authorized user instead.

you_see.t: A question from Compliance that no ruleset is active.

test.t: No compliance ruleset is loaded. A listing's description and a signed campaign "Bright kitchen near the park" both go to Compliance.

when.t: A signed new campaign carries demographic targeting.

steps.t: Agent 12 refuses it and raises a legal-line alert; it is not sent to Compliance.
A farm campaign (an area, no listing) may only use general targeting; anything else raises the same alert.

never.t: Target by age, family status or any other demographic.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert about the demographic targeting.

test.t: A signed campaign targeting ages 25 to 40.

title.t: A published ad is out of date

when.t: A report arrives that an ad is stale, saying whether to retract or correct it.

steps.t: To retract: Agent 12 sends a retraction, which the dispatcher holds for the authorized user's release, logs what changed, and tells the authorized user.
To correct (the default): it reopens the ad for correction, logs the change and tells the authorized user; the corrected copy goes back through Compliance and release.

Only an ad that was released is retracted (in the test it was). An ad still held for release is not retracted: the authorized user is asked to decline it; with no ad ever published there is nothing to retract, and the authorized user is told so (fixed 2026-10-28).

steps.t: There is no connection to any ad platform: this reaches Agent 12 only as an incoming message of that kind.

never.t: Leave a stale ad up past the day without correcting or retracting it.

you_see.t: A note that a retraction is held for release, with what changed.

test.t: A listing goes live and its ad is released; a report then says the price changed from 450,000 to 439,000 on the MLS and asks for retraction.

title.t: Someone changes the budget by word of mouth

why.t: Retired 2026-10-28 (owner decision): no ad carries a cost and nothing is bought, so the signed budget guarded nothing. A budget setting is now refused.

when.t: Compliance returns a flagged verdict on campaign copy.

steps.t: Agent 12 publishes nothing and tells the authorized user, with Compliance's findings, to send corrected copy as a new signed campaign.

never.t: Publish flagged copy or edit it itself.

you_see.t: A question with Compliance's findings (for example FH-1, "perfect for young families").

test.t: A signed campaign "Perfect for young families near the park".
